class.name: FellowMixSnapshot
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: a state of the mix — the buses' levels it changes, how fast it comes in and goes out.
class.description: Pushed and popped on a [FellowAudioDirector] ([method FellowAudioDirector.push_snapshot]), or in its [member FellowAudioDirector.snapshots] with a [member trigger_bus]: active while one of the director's voices plays on that bus (a duck: the music lowered while someone speaks). While active its weight rises to 1 over [member fade_in], afterwards falls to 0 over [member fade_out]; each bus in [member bus_volumes] is set to its level before the snapshots plus the active snapshots' changes times their weights, and given back its level when none changes it.

members.member: The changes: a bus's name and the dB added to its level.
Seconds to come in fully (its weight 0 to 1, the change in dB following it).
When set (and the snapshot is in the director's [member FellowAudioDirector.snapshots]), the snapshot is active while a voice of the director plays on this bus.
